text:
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert -> smart-routing-prod: sudden 5xx spike + surge in retries. Creating INC-3459.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3459 (P1) created. Paging @ajay-oncall and @dave-sre.

ajay-oncall: I'm on it. Seeing a huge number of 500s from /v1/generate routed through smart-routing. Traffic looks like it doubled in the last 60s.

sam-client-eng: We're seeing lots of client-side retries on both 500 and 429. Some SDKs retry aggressively (initial backoff 0ms). That might be amplifying things.

maria-ml: Quick glance at logs: many 500s have "decoder signature mismatch" when invoking model instances in eu-west. Possible wrong variant was routed to.

carla-platform: The routing policy 'region-fallback' was recently updated. It specifies fallback_model: redwood-chat-v2 but our runtime expects redwood-chat-v2-quant in eu-west. Looks like the mapping lost the variant tag. Posting snippet.

carla-platform:
```
policy: region-fallback
priorities:
  - region: us-west
  - region: eu-west
fallback_model: redwood-chat-v2
# expected fallback_model: redwood-chat-v2-quant (variant tag missing)
```

dave-sre: That would explain immediate 500s. Clients see 500 and retry; the retry then triggers fallback to the other region which also doesn't have the correct variant -> cascade / thundering herd.

ajay-oncall: Mitigation plan in order of operations:
1) Disable cross-region fallback so we stop routing to incompatible variants.
2) Apply temporary rate limiting at smart-routing ingress to shed retry flood.
3) Patch model-catalog mapping to include variant tag and deploy.
4) Make client SDKs treat this error as non-retryable.

ajay-oncall: I'm disabling region-fallback now.

carla-platform: Confirmed: region-fallback toggled to OFF. Routing now returns an immediate 503 with header x-rw-error: no-compatible-variant. That should prevent cross-region cascades.

sam-client-eng: Our telemetry shows SDKs switched from retrying on 500 to stopping on 503. Retry storm subsided almost immediately.

maria-ml: Working on a hotfix to the model catalog mapping. Pushing change to config-store with correct variant name (redwood-chat-v2-quant).

dave-sre: Applying cluster-level token-bucket rate limit to smart-routing ingress to bring QPS back to baseline while we fix catalog.

incident-bot: INC-3459 assigned to current oncall. Handoff to @maria-ml scheduled in 45m.

lee-cs: Quick customer note: some customers experienced elevated errors and latency between 12:07-12:14 UTC. We're preparing a status update.

maria-ml: Hotfix deployed to model catalog. Verified requests destined for eu-west now route to redwood-chat-v2-quant and are returning 200s.

ajay-oncall: Waiting 5m for metrics to stabilize, then we will re-enable fallback with corrected mapping.

dave-sre: 5m healthy window observed. Re-enabled region-fallback with corrected mapping. No further retry amplification observed.

ajay-oncall: Post-incident actions: 
- Add variant-tag validation into routing policy compiler so a mapping that drops variant tags fails CI.
- Add a circuit-breaker in smart-routing to detect and short-circuit failover loops.
- Update client SDK defaults to treat decoder-signature/variant-mismatch errors as non-retryable.
- Add runbook steps for rapid fallback disable + rate-limit during failover storms.

lee-cs: I'll coordinate customer comms and identify affected customers for follow-up.

ajay-oncall: Handoff to @maria-ml for the postmortem write-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
